##### Project general facts
La Perla Homes 10 & 12 by GHD Developments present a refined collection of smart townhouses in JVC, thoughtfully designed to reflect exclusivity and modern luxury. Inspired by the elegance of a pearl, the architecture combines clean contemporary lines with soft neutral tones, creating a timeless visual identity. The project is distributed across two boutique clusters – La Perla Homes 10 in District 10 and La Perla Homes 12 in District 12 – offering a limited selection of 4-bedroom homes with a maid’s room. Each residence is carefully planned with spacious interiors, private elevators, rooftop or private pools, and expansive balconies that enhance light, openness, and privacy.

The development offers a curated lifestyle enriched with premium amenities designed for comfort and exclusivity. Residents benefit from private rooftop swimming pools, landscaped outdoor spaces, and thoughtfully designed areas that enhance relaxation and leisure within a low-density community setting. Every element is crafted to ensure a sense of privacy and sophistication, where each townhouse feels like a standalone villa experience within a secure and well-planned environment.

Inside, the homes feature high-quality modern finishes with elegant detailing, floor-to-ceiling windows, and carefully selected materials that enhance brightness and space. Smart home automation systems allow full control of lighting and ambience, while built-in storage solutions ensure practical everyday living. Kitchens come fully equipped with premium built-in appliances from leading brands and are designed as open-plan spaces connected to the living area, with the option for separation if desired. The project is delivered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalise their interiors to their own style.

##### Location description and benefits 

Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) is a vibrant residential community in Dubai, known for its family-friendly environment and balanced mix of modern urban living and tranquil suburban ambiance. Situated in the heart of new Dubai, JVC offers a blend of villas, townhouses, and apartments, making it an attractive location for both families and young professionals. The area is designed to provide residents with a sense of community, with its wide range of amenities including parks, schools, and healthcare facilities, all within easy reach.

The architecture in JVC is a blend of traditional Arabian and modern styles, contributing to its unique charm. The community is well-connected to key areas of Dubai through major highways like Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, making it convenient for residents to commute to work, school, or entertainment hubs. The community's layout is thoughtfully planned, with lush green spaces, walking paths, and communal areas that encourage outdoor activities and social interaction.

In addition to residential options, JVC is home to a variety of retail outlets, dining establishments, and leisure facilities, ensuring that residents have everything they need close at hand. The ongoing development in the area continues to enhance its appeal, making JVC a sought-after location for those looking to experience a balanced lifestyle in the bustling city of Dubai.
